name: COFFEE Tsunami! ☕️🌊
desc:
✨ Coffee Tsunami Challenge! ✨

💖 How to Play:

Run to the finish line!
When there's a flood warning, climb up!
Wait for the COFFEE WAVE to pass, then dash to the end and win!
💫 Tip: The longer the start button isn't pressed, the higher the COFFEE TSUNAMI!
